# Transliteration Scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TransliterationScheme>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A named transliteration/romanization/transcription system (Hepburn, Pinyin, ISO 233, IPA, …). A value carried by [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](../properties/gmeow-transliterationScheme.md); the major schemes are catalogued as FnO functions in the projection layer (projections/transforms.fno.ttl).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the transliteration axis — the named systems (Hepburn, Pinyin, ISO 233, IPA, …) a romanization can declare it was produced by via [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](../properties/gmeow-transliterationScheme.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-scheme subclasses (schemes are individuals) and avoid using it for the romanized string or the script itself ([`gmeow:WritingSystem`](gmeow-WritingSystem.md)); a scheme is a transform, not a script.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded scheme individual from a romanization via [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](../properties/gmeow-transliterationScheme.md); the major schemes are catalogued as FnO functions in projections/transforms.fno.ttl, so a consumer can resolve the individual to its executable transform.

### Examples

- ex:schemeHepburn a [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md).
